_comment: OpenTelemetry (OTel) configuration — issue #5081 (S1) + #5138 (destination switches) + #5082 (S2 metrics), observability program #5080. The single externalized source for every OTel switch. No module hard-codes an OTel value; change this file (or the matching env var) to change behavior, then update the pins in tests/otel_config_5081.test.ts and tests/otel_destinations_5138.test.ts that quote the value. Resolution order (the PAYMENTS_FLOW_MODE pattern): run > session > user > env > this file > built-in safe default (all OFF / none / 0). The built-in safe default applies only when this file is missing or a value is invalid; an invalid value fails closed to OFF with a coded OBS-1001 message and does NOT fall through. destinations: one switch per destination (Analytics Engine sink, R2 OTLP export, console sink) — all ON here, preserving the current behavior; each is individually flippable via its OTEL_DESTINATION_<NAME>_ENABLED env var. Workers Logs is NOT a switch in this file: it is deploy-time only, wrangler.jsonc observability.enabled (set false to silence it entirely; currently true at 1% sampling, persist false per #4131). The Worker cannot flip the Cloudflare platform log pipeline at runtime — no runtime switch exists for it, and none is pretended here. S2 (#5082): metricsExporter is otlp (the live signal now); the metrics section carries the export interval (60000ms), the Analytics Engine free-tier limits (100k writes/day, 10k read queries/day — config values, not hard-coded), the pipeline health max failure rate (0.05), and the resource SLO max pct (0.7). The metrics ingestion route is /api/otel/v1/metrics (same token gate as the logs route).
